about_the_game:
Alchemic Beasts: Restore Mizu, Tame Beasts, and Unleash The Power Of Alchemy!


Join Zieg in Alchemic Beasts, a thrilling monster taming adventure where he seeks revenge and restoration in the paradise of Mizu. After a dangerous encounter, Zieg is revived to tame unruly beasts, reclaim Mizu, and bring back its lost paradise.

Features

  • Capture and Evolve Beasts: Use alchemy to capture over 200 unique beasts. Evolve them with elemental ores and turn them into powerful allies.
  • Stagger System: Engage in strategic battles using the Stagger System. Stagger foes to unleash devastating combo attacks.
  • Forge Bonds: Build strong bonds with your beasts. Manage their energies in turn-based battles to defeat foes.
  • Explore Mizu: Journey through Mizu, overrun by beasts. Restore its former glory by defeating the menace and rebuilding the town.
  • Mad Science: Harvest and craft recourses to create alchemic potions and food to keep your monsters strong.

Gameplay

  • Master Alchemy: Capture, evolve, and breed beasts. Customize your team for tactical advantages.
  • Tactical Combat: Use elemental abilities to stagger enemies. Open them up for powerful attacks.
  • Restore Mizu: Complete missions to reclaim Mizu. Bring back inhabitants and rebuild the town.
  • Manage Your Lab: Refine ores, unlock abilities, and enhance your beasts with alchemy.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-Core, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 8800 GT 512 MB, Radeon HD 4870 512 MB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card

short_description: Alchemic Beasts is a monster taming RPG adventure where you breed and transmute creatures using alchemy to forge powerful monsters. Join Zeig, a thrill seeking daredevil, as he harnesses his alchemic beasts to defeat the creature known as the legendary Demon King.
